question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

The couple walked towards the opposite end of the dungeon, where she previously played with destieny.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"destieny"** is incorrectly spelt and should be*** "destiny"***. (भाग्य)

 
 
• **Example: **She believed it was her** destiny** to become a great artist.
 
 
 
• **"Destiny" **refers to the events that will necessarily happen to a particular person or thing in the future. (भाग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He felt that meeting her was his** destiny.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is '**destiny'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dungeon **(कालकोठरी): A dark, often underground prison cell.

 
 
• **Example:** The prisoners were kept in a **dungeon** beneath the castle.
 
 
 
• **Couple **(जोड़ा ): Two individuals considered together.
 
 
• **Example: **The** couple **celebrated their anniversary with a romantic dinner.
 
 
 
• **Previously** (पहले): At a previous or earlier time.
 
 
• **Example:** She had **previously** worked as a teacher before becoming an author.
